about: Connections (appendix A 21, 24): one response's data for a surface, read into records, groups (one group per edge: the posts one feed or profile unit carries together) and its continuation. surface names where the connection and its items sit: feed (feedData, items text_post_app_thread.thread_items[].post), profile_tab (mediaData, items thread_items[].post), search_posts (searchResults, items thread.thread_items[].post), search_accounts (xdt_api__v1__users__search_connection, nodes are users), followers (user.followers, nodes are users), following (user.following), liked (xdt_text_app_viewer.liked_media, items thread_items[].post), saved (xdt_text_app_viewer.saved_media). policy: relay (has_next_page bool + string cursor), offset (numeric string cursor), capped (one server-chosen sample + reported total), single_batch (one batch). expected.groups lists ids per group; relations give, for a post after the first in its group, what it is to an earlier post of that group: reply (another author answers) or continuation (the same author continues their own post). An object {"$user": "A", ...} stands for users.A merged with its other keys. All content is synthetic. Every synthetic code is the shortcode of its post's pk (base64url digits, targets.json shortcodes), so a post URL names that same post with no request.

cases.name: feed-unit-keeps-reply-relation
cases.fact: One feed unit can carry a post and a reply to it (or an author's continuation). They are one group, and the reply says which post it answers, so it never reads as an unrelated post.
cases.verify: P2: whether a feed continuation carries reply_to_id like a reply, and whether a feed unit can hold a reply whose parent is not in the unit.

cases.name: feed-tombstone-kept-in-place
cases.fact: A tombstone in a listing is an unavailable marker at its position; its neighbours stay readable.

cases.name: profile-tab-with-pinned
cases.fact: A profile tab page is mediaData edges of thread units; a pinned post carries is_pinned.

cases.name: search-posts
cases.fact: Post search results are searchResults edges whose node.thread carries the thread items.

cases.name: search-accounts-single-batch
cases.fact: Account search is one batch of users: there is no continuation, so it stops as not paginable.

cases.name: followers-capped-sample
cases.fact: Followers are one server-chosen sample; the reported total (counts.followers) can be far larger than the batch.

cases.name: following-offset-cursor
cases.fact: Following pages by a numeric offset cursor; the next page is the same tab query with that offset as after.

cases.name: following-non-numeric-cursor
cases.fact: A continuing following page whose cursor is not an offset is a changed shape.

cases.name: liked-single-batch
cases.fact: Liked posts are one batch of thread units.

cases.name: saved-single-batch
cases.fact: Saved posts are one batch of thread units.

cases.name: continuing-page-without-cursor
cases.fact: has_next_page true without a cursor is a changed shape, never the end.

cases.name: page-info-missing
cases.fact: A paged surface without page_info.has_next_page as a boolean is a changed shape.

cases.name: edges-missing
cases.fact: A connection without an explicit edges list is a changed shape, not an empty result.

cases.name: explicit-empty
cases.fact: An explicit empty edges list with no next page is a real empty result.

cases.name: thread-item-without-post
cases.fact: A thread item without its post object is a changed shape.
